caption: One half of the SST tag team, out of the Bronx, whose own bio card bills him a three-time Prairie Champion — the current holder as of March 1999 — a three-time Six Man Champion, a three-time Tag Team and TV Tag Team Champion, and a onetime Eastern Champion.
name: Craig Savage Jr.

tenures.note: Billed "HotStuff" Craig Savage Jr.; his own bio card lists ICP, DX and DM as current allies and RR, Flock as current enemies (none minted — no further context survives). His own bio card also bills him Eastern, three-time Tag Team and three-time TV Tag Team Champion, and a six-time TV Six Man Champion; the additional reigns these support are structured in reigns.json (see iml-eastern's, iml-tag-team's, iml-tv-tag's and iml-prairie's own notes) except TV Six Man, whose count conflicts with T.A.F.K.A.C.'s own bio card (three) and is left unstructured, per iml-tv-six-man's own notes.

caption: SST's own tag partner out of the Bronx and the fed's own promo-column voice, billed by his own bio card a five-time Dixie Champion, a three-time Six Man Champion, a three-time TV Six Man Champion, and a onetime Southern Champion.
name: T.A.F.K.A.C.

tenures.finisher: The Symbolic Experience (Outsider's Edge from top rope)
tenures.note: Also cuts the fed's own in-character promo column (rumors.html) as "TAFKAC." His own bio card also bills him a three-time TV Six Man Champion and a Southern Champion (count unspecified); the additional Dixie, Six Man and Southern reigns these support are structured in reigns.json (see iml-dixie's, iml-six-man's and iml-southern's own notes). His own three-time TV Six Man count does not match the Savage brothers' own six-time claim, per iml-tv-six-man's own notes; no TV Six Man reign beyond the current one is structured here.
